test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

May you be blessed with good health!

options.text: May God blessed you with good health!
May you bless God with good health!
May God bless you with good health!
May God be blessing you with good health!

solution:
The passive voice of the given sentence is __**May God bless you with good health!**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Optative sentence__

 
• to shows a prayer or a wish. It starts with ‘**may**’ or ‘**wish**’.

 
 
 
 

 
 **Active**
 
 
 **Passive**
 
 
 

 May + Subject + V1 + object.
 
 May + Object + V3 + by + subject
 
 
 

 
• 
 The instructions given below should be followed while changing an optative sentence to a passive voice.

 
 
• 
 Find the subject and object of the sentence and exchange their places; make changes in their cases as well if subject and object are pronouns.
 
 
• 
 Use the preposition 'by' before the agent.
 
 
• 
 The place of the optative word 'may' remains the same.
 
 
• 
 Always use the third form of the main verb in passive form.
 
 
• 
 At last line up the remaining part.
 
 
 

So, the final sentence is -* May God bless you with good health!*
